message: Structure habitat index is not computable; missing required metrics: height_p95_m, cover_gt_1_37_pct, complexity_sd_gt_1_37_m. Proxies are reported but not substituted.

proxies.complexity_sd_gt_1_37_m: no first-return height standard deviation field is available
proxies.cover_gt_1_37_pct: chm_cover_ge_2 uses a 2 m threshold, not 1.37 m
proxies.height_p95_m: chm_p95 is CHM-derived, not first-return P95
